author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The dust has barely settled after yesterday's seismic news of another major shake-up at Xbox. Leadership positions at Halo Studios and Gears of War developer The Coalition have taken a hit. Juan Vaca, story director for Gears of War: E-Day has been let go, just under a week before the game was set to launch on early access. And Josh Daniels, Cinematic Director for Halo, was promoted and then laid off in the same week. Layoffs at Halo Studios are not too surprising as Xbox is giving Activision the keys to Halo, but job losses at The Coalition are concerning considering Microsoft has not made any announcements about that studio. And in related news, Xbox is set to debut a new achievement: the mythic achievement, which will be their equivalent to a PlayStation platinum trophy. The sound of the new achievement has already been discovered.

#ign #gaming
title: Halo and Gears of War Leadership Hit Hard in Latest Xbox Layoffs - IGN Daily Fix

Take a look at the 'Say Something' Clip for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Don't miss this tense conversation between Anna and Verity in Verity, in theaters on October 2.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.

author: IGN
description:
What are are the differences between Control Resonant's graphics modes on the PlayStation 5 and the PS5 Pro? 

Starting off with the base PS5 you’ve got the choice of your standard performance and quality modes. Performance has the game running at a native lower fidelity that’s upscaled to 1440p but runs at a pretty solid target 60fps. Quality mode, on the other hand looks great, but comes at a cost a target frame rate of 30, and an upscaled output to 4k.

The PlayStation 5 pro unlocks the game a bit more and offers three graphics modes that all output at an upscaled 4K resolution thanks to PSSR. 

Quality looks the best with hardware enables ray tracing, a sharp image, and a much more noticeable visual fidelity across the board. BUT you can’t have everything because it’s locked at a target 30fps. 

Performance offers a lower fidelity and no ray tracing but It runs at 60fps.
Balanced is a mode I hope we see more often as it has improved visuals like quality mode, but squeezes out a fe
title: Control: Resonant - PlayStation 5 vs PS5 Pro Graphics Comparison

Check out the Official Trailer 2 for Wild Horse Nine, an early 70s era spy crime drama comedy distributed by Searchlight Pictures. Longtime partners face issues of the past on an intense mission in Wild Horse Nine, in theaters November 6.

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

Wild Horse Nine stars John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell, Steve Buscemi, Mariana di Girolamo, Ailín Salas, with Tom Waits, and Parker Posey. The film is directed and written by Martin McDonagh and produced by Graham Broadbent, Pete Czernin, Martin McDonagh, and Anita Overland.

Wild Horse Nine is in theaters on November 6.

author: IGN
description: Valve has officially realeased all their promised new hardware for everyone. Unfortunately what should have been an industry game changer turned out to be a bit underwhelming, not because the hardware itself is underwhelming, but because of accessibility due to market changes thanks to AI and rising costs across the board. While the new Steam Machine, Steam Frame, and Steam Controller launched with little hype, that doesn't change how much of an impact this hardware should have had across the board. With the Linux-based SteamOS as a solid replacement for Windows 11 and console-like PC gaming, Steam's hardware was meant to be the start of something great for PC gaming.
title: Valve’s Hardware Was Supposed to Change PC Gaming

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan dive deep into the latest happenings at Microsoft. This week the company announced another round of layoffs and a significant reshuffling of their remaining studios, which has resulted in Activision getting their shot at Halo, Obsidian being folded into Bethesda, and more. Would Activision's Halo be more Call of Duty than Halo? And would that be such a bad thing? What does this mean for Bungie, who has just announced a return of sorts to Destiny 2? And what will become of Rare, who is also moving into Activision's stable of developers? Plus we have last week's poll results and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN, Spotify, and Discord.
Join us on our Discord server https://discord.gg/uRvkrfAws
title: No Franchise Is Safe As Phase Two of Xbox’s Reset Begins - Next-Gen Console Watch
